description:
Digitize a medical intake form by adding interactive form controls to the draft document at '/home/ga/Documents/intake_form_draft.odt'. You must use the 'Form Controls' toolbar (View > Toolbars > Form Controls) to insert specific controls next to their corresponding text labels. 

Required Controls and Configuration:
1. 'Full Name': Insert a Text Box. Open 'Control Properties' and set Name to 'full_name'.
2. 'Date of Birth': Insert a Date Field. Set Name to 'dob'.
3. 'Gender' section: Insert 3 Option Buttons (Radio Buttons). All three MUST have the Name 'gender' to function as a group. Set their Labels to 'Male', 'Female', and 'Non-Binary' respectively. Set their Reference Values (in properties) to 'M', 'F', and 'NB'.
4. 'Medical History' section: Insert 3 Checkboxes. Set their Names to 'hist_asthma', 'hist_diabetes', and 'hist_hypertension' respectively.

Save the final interactive form as '/home/ga/Documents/intake_form_interactive.odt'.
